limits: This is an OSM-conditioned roof-production comparison, not end-to-end footprint detection.

The frozen reference-footprint arm contains known numeric degenerate rings; OSM production uses uniform 1e-8m numeric cleanup. Differences confound footprint source/partition and numeric robustness; they cannot all be attributed to OSM.
Official source object identity is not individual-house ground truth. Split/merge statistics are diagnostics only.

Native-complete/nonempty counts describe the chosen input entities. Cross-footprint success-rate differences confound entity granularity; use fixed-ROI area/line comparisons for geometric performance.
All source/reference epochs differ; unsupported or extra relative-to-reference geometry is not automatically erroneous.
No absolute-height accuracy is reported. DC source Z units/datum remain unresolved. Breakline normal/step tests use nominal Z and are geometric diagnostics.
Boston source LoD1.5/3 models are external geometric references, not uniformly certified LoD2 ground truth.
This production diagnostic retains all 1756 frozen official source objects, including previously studied development records; it is not a new held-out accuracy estimate.
ROI clipping happens only in evaluation; inference receives independent, uncropped OSM building geometry.
Roof coverage has a fixed full-reference-area denominator and retains all missing/failed predictions.

Breakline precision/F1 uses all predicted lines within the fixed official footprint union inside core_bounds, not prediction/reference intersections or successful matches; recall uses every reference line. Unsupported ROI lines are reported separately and not declared false positives.

All arms use a uniform1e-8m grid for evaluation-only XY overlays after a full-precision GEOS non-noded-intersection failure. Original models/points remain unchanged; per-arm area changes must pass the declared perimeter-based nanometre rounding budget.
